# `company.purchase_profiles`

Immutable one-to-one bill revision headers with captured vendor, payable, terms and reference facts.

Database: `company`.

| Column | SQL type | Nullable | Default | Key | Indexes | References | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `revision_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | primary key 1, unique with transaction_id + revision_id | — | transaction_revisions.id | Immutable revision owning this one-to-one purchase header. |
| `transaction_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | unique with transaction_id + revision_id | — | transaction_revisions.transaction_id, transactions.id | Stable purchase document owning this revision. |
| `created_at` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | — | UTC time this purchase history was written. |
| `created_by` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | — | Company principal that wrote this purchase history. |
| `created_via` | VARCHAR(16) | no | — | — | — | — | Interface that wrote this purchase history. |
| `type` | VARCHAR(32) | no | — | — | — | transactions.type | Purchase document type; bill is the only implemented one. |
| `vendor_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | ix_purchase_profiles_reference | vendors.id | Vendor the obligation is owed to. |
| `ap_account_id` | VARCHAR(26) | no | — | — | — | accounts.id | Accounts payable account credited for the gross. |
| `terms_id` | VARCHAR(26) | yes | — | — | — | terms.id | Captured payment terms; null when the bill carries none. |
| `due_date` | VARCHAR(10) | no | — | — | — | — | Captured due date, derived from terms or entered outright. |
| `supplier_reference` | VARCHAR(128) | yes | — | — | — | — | The supplier's own document number, as entered; null when blank. |
| `supplier_reference_key` | VARCHAR(256) | yes | — | — | ix_purchase_profiles_reference | — | NFC-normalized, trimmed and case-folded reference used to detect a repeat; null when blank. |
| `expense_total_minor_units` | BIGINT | no | — | — | — | — | Home-currency sum of the expense lines. |
| `profile_snapshot` | TEXT | no | — | — | — | — | Versioned typed JSON object of resolved header facts and input origins. |
